%root% { padding-top: var(--space-xl); overflow: hidden; }
%root%::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(50em 30em at 85% 30%, var(--primary-trans-20), transparent 65%); }

name: svc-hero__grid
css:
%root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, .9fr); gap: var(--space-xl); align-items: center; width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

name: svc-hero__content
css: %root% { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--space-l); min-width: 0; }

name: svc-hero__title
css: %root% .serif { color: var(--primary-light); }

name: svc-hero__lede
css: %root% { font-size: var(--text-l); color: var(--white-trans-80); max-width: 54ch; }

name: byline
css:
%root% { display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-s); font-size: var(--text-s); color: var(--text-light-muted); padding-top: var(--space-s); border-top: var(--pnw-border-dark); width: 100%; }
%root% strong { color: var(--white); }

name: byline__av
css: %root% { width: 2.6em; height: 2.6em; aspect-ratio: 1; flex: none; border-radius: var(--radius-circle); display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--primary); color: var(--white); font-family: var(--heading-font-family); font-weight: 800; font-size: var(--text-s); }

name: byline__text
css: %root% { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }

name: svc-hero__media
css: %root% { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-s); min-width: 0; }

name: svc-hero__art
css:
%root% { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 10 / 7; width: 100%; border-radius: var(--radius-l); overflow: hidden; border: var(--border-size) solid var(--white-trans-20); box-shadow: var(--box-shadow-l); background: radial-gradient(70% 90% at 30% 50%, var(--primary-trans-20), transparent 70%), var(--base-dark); }
%root% svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }

name: svc-hero__cap
css: %root% { font-size: var(--text-s); color: var(--text-light-muted); }

name: answer__grid
css:
%root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-l); align-items: stretch; width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

name: answer__card
facts
css: %root% { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--space-s); align-items: stretch; }

name: fact
css: %root% { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: .35em; padding: var(--space-m); border-radius: var(--radius-l); background: var(--base); color: var(--white); }

name: fact__label
css: %root% { font-family: var(--pnw-font-mono); font-size: var(--text-xs); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-light-muted); }

name: fact__value
css:
%root% { margin: 0; font-family: var(--heading-font-family); font-weight: 800; font-size: calc(var(--h4) * 1.17); letter-spacing: -.01em; line-height: 1.15; }
@media (max-width: 478px) { %root% { font-size: var(--text-m); } }

name: fit__grid
css:
%root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--space-l); width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

name: fit-card
css: %root% { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-m); padding: var(--space-l); border-radius: var(--radius-l); border: var(--pnw-border); background: var(--neutral-ultra-light); }

name: fit-card--yes
css: %root% { background: var(--white); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 35%, var(--neutral-light)); box-shadow: var(--box-shadow-m); }

name: fit-card--no
css: %root% .fit-card__ico { background: var(--accent); color: var(--base); }

name: fit-card__head
css: %root% { display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-s); }

name: fit-card__ico
css:
%root% { width: 3em; height: 3em; aspect-ratio: 1; flex: none; border-radius: var(--radius-circle); display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--primary); color: var(--white); }
%root% svg { width: 1.4em; height: 1.4em; }

name: fit-card__title
css: %root% { font-size: calc(var(--h4) * 1.3); }

name: fit-card__list
css: %root% { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: var(--pnw-border); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }

name: fit-card__item
fit-card__alt
fit-card__alt--static

inside__grid
css:
%root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--space-l); width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

name: still
css: %root% { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-s); }

name: still__feed
css: %root% { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; width: 100%; border-radius: var(--radius-l); box-shadow: var(--box-shadow-l); }

name: still__tag
css: %root% { padding: .2em .55em; border-radius: var(--radius-circle); background: var(--black-trans-50); font-weight: 700; }

name: still__tag--after
css: %root% { background: var(--primary); }

name: still__cap
css:
%root% { font-size: var(--text-s); color: var(--text-dark-muted); }
%root% strong { color: var(--text-dark); }

name: specs__grid
css:
%root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: var(--space-xxl); align-items: start; width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--space-xl); } }

name: spec-table
css: %root% { margin: 0; border-top: var(--border-size) solid var(--text-dark); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; width: 100%; }

name: spec-table__row
css:
%root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: var(--space-m); padding: var(--space-m) 0; border-bottom: var(--pnw-border); align-items: baseline; }
@media (max-width: 478px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: calc(var(--space-xs) / 2); } }

name: spec-table__term
css: %root% { font-family: var(--pnw-font-mono); font-size: var(--text-xs); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--neutral); }

name: spec-table__value
css: %root% { margin: 0; font-family: var(--heading-font-family); font-weight: 700; font-size: var(--h4); }

name: cost__grid
css:
%root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, .9fr); gap: var(--space-xxl); align-items: center; width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--space-xl); } }

name: cost__text
css:
%root% { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--space-m); }
%root% > p { color: var(--text-dark-muted); font-size: var(--text-l); max-width: 56ch; }

name: cost__range
css:
%root% { font-family: var(--heading-font-family); font-weight: 700; font-size: calc(var(--h3) * 1.08); line-height: 1.25; color: var(--text-dark); }
.cost__text > %root% { color: var(--text-dark); font-size: calc(var(--h3) * 1.08); }

name: cost__incl
css: .cost__text > %root% { font-size: var(--text-m); }

name: cost-card
css:
%root% { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-m); padding: var(--space-l); border-radius: var(--radius-l); background: var(--base); color: var(--text-light); box-shadow: var(--box-shadow-l); }
%root% :is(h3) { color: var(--text-light); }

name: cost-card__title
css: %root% { font-size: calc(var(--h4) * 1.22); }

name: cost-card__list
css: %root% { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: var(--pnw-border-dark); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }

name: cost-card__item
css: %root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.5em minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-s); padding: var(--space-s) 0; border-bottom: var(--pnw-border-dark); color: var(--white-trans-80); }

name: cost-card__num
css: %root% { font-family: var(--pnw-font-mono); color: var(--accent); font-size: var(--text-s); padding-top: .2em; }

name: owner__grid
css:
%root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .7fr) minmax(0, 1.3fr); gap: var(--space-xxl); align-items: center; width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--space-xl); } }

name: owner__photo
css:
%root% { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; width: 100%; border-radius: var(--radius-l); overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--base-light), var(--base-dark)); color: var(--text-light-muted); border: var(--pnw-border-dark); }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; max-width: 28em; } }

name: owner__content
css: %root% { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--space-l); min-width: 0; }

name: owner__title
css: %root% .serif { color: var(--primary-light); }

name: owner__quote
css:
%root% { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; font-family: var(--pnw-font-serif); font-size: calc(var(--h3) * 1.29); line-height: 1.2; color: var(--text-light); }
%root%::before { content: "\201C"; display: block; font-size: 2.5em; line-height: .6; color: var(--primary-light); margin-bottom: .1em; }

name: owner__creds
css: %root% { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-xs); }

name: owner__cred
css:
%root% { width: auto; display: inline-flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: center; gap: .5em; padding: .45em .85em; border-radius: var(--radius-circle); border: var(--pnw-border-dark); background: var(--white-trans-10); font-size: var(--text-s); font-weight: 600; }
%root% svg { width: 1.1em; height: 1.1em; color: var(--primary-light); }

name: jobs__grid
css:
%root% { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-m); width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

name: job
css:
%root% { height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: var(--radius-l); overflow: hidden; border: var(--pnw-border); background: var(--neutral-ultra-light); transition: transform .35s var(--pnw-ease), box-shadow .35s; }
%root%:hover { transform: translateY(-.25em); box-shadow: var(--box-shadow-m); }

name: job__body
css: %root% { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .35em; padding: var(--space-m); }

name: job__title
css: %root% { font-family: var(--heading-font-family); font-weight: 800; font-size: var(--h4); }

name: job__spec
css: %root% { color: var(--text-dark-muted); font-size: var(--text-s); }

name: quotes__grid
css:
%root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--space-m); width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

name: more__grid
css:
%root% { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-xxl); align-items: start; width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 991px) { %root% { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--space-xl); } }

name: related
css: %root% { list-style: none; margin: var(--space-m) 0 0; padding: 0; border-top: var(--border-size) solid var(--text-dark); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; width: 100%; }

name: related__link
related__ico
css:
%root% { width: calc(var(--text-m) * 2.75); height: calc(var(--text-m) * 2.75); aspect-ratio: 1; flex: none; border-radius: var(--radius-circle); display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--white); border: var(--pnw-border); color: var(--primary); }
%root% svg { width: 1.2em; height: 1.2em; }

name: related__label
css: %root% { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }

name: related__go
css: %root% { width: 1.1em; height: 1.1em; flex: none; color: var(--neutral); }

name: near
css: %root% { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--space-m); }

name: near__title
css: %root% { font-size: calc(var(--h2) * .64); }

name: near__cities
css: %root% { display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-xs); }

name: near__city
css:
%root% { padding: .55em 1em; border-radius: var(--radius-circle); background: var(--white); border: var(--pnw-border); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dark); transition: background-color .25s, color .25s, border-color .25s; }
%root%:hover { background: var(--base); color: var(--white); border-color: var(--base); }
